entries.title: Merge past your branch rules, only on your click
entries.body: When your GitHub account may skip your default branch's rules, a crewmate can prepare a merge that skips them, such as a release still waiting on a code owner's review. Its card lists every rule and failed check it skips, and only your click merges it, squashed into one commit, once, at the version you saw.

picture.alt: A card titled Merge the release past its rules, listing a review rule, required checks and one failed check above a Merge, skipping the rules button.
